title: The role of potassium and zinc in reducing salinity and alkalinity stress conditions in two wheat genotypes
journal: Archives of Agronomy and Soil Science
notes: This paper does NOT report grain Zn concentration. It reports grain protein content (%) and grain yield under Zn x K factorial treatments in saline/alkaline conditions. No Zn concentration in grain was measured, so no Zn biofortification observations can be extracted for the Hui 2023 meta-analysis.
